items.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Debuts Autonomous CRM Engine For Enterprise CRM Modernization
items.summary: ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) introduced its Autonomous CRM Engine, an AI native platform for enterprise CRM modernization and automation. The new engine focuses on accelerating complex CRM migrations and deployments by using AI driven discovery and configuration tools. Early enterprise adopters are already using the Autonomous CRM Engine to overhaul legacy customer relationship workflows and related processes. The Autonomous CRM Engine launch is a fresh development that investors may want to weigh...
